tasks.name: cloud_timeout_ms capped at 2000
tasks.description: config.load caps cloud_timeout_ms at 2000, keeping 500 ms for the local fallback.
acceptance: cloud_timeout_ms above 2000 loads as 2000 with a warning; below 500 resets to 1500

tasks.name: The URL guard in the libretranslate adapter
tasks.description: URLs go to translate as X_n placeholders and come back intact, or the translation fails.
acceptance: The libretranslate request carries X_n in place of each URL, and the result carries the URLs as typed
A placeholder missing or doubled in the output fails the translation with bad_guard; the draft stays
The openai and anthropic requests are unchanged

tasks.name: The cache and the route, with the cloud-to-local fallback
tasks.description: route.translate picks the answer: the cache, the active slot, then the local slot for a failed cloud.
acceptance: A failed cloud request is followed by one local request with a 500 ms timeout; its success is marked fallback
A local failure is never sent to the cloud; too_long never falls back
A cached slot and draft make no request; errors are never cached

tasks.name: Enter retries in error; the processor uses the route
tasks.description: decide returns translate for Enter in error; the processor calls route.translate; the fallback prompt shows.
acceptance: Enter in error translates again and commits nothing; Shift+Enter commits the Chinese
A fallback result shows as '  ☁✗ -> ' and the next Enter commits it
Esc then Enter on the same draft makes no second request when the active slot's own translation is cached; after a fallback it asks the cloud again (the user's decision, 2026-09-23)

tasks.name: README, template; real-machine smoke
tasks.description: The docs describe the fallback, the retry and the cap; the user runs the smoke in TextEdit.
acceptance: A URL survives a local translation, spaced (user)
A failed cloud shows '☁✗ -> ' within 2.5 s and Enter commits it (user)
Enter after a local error commits nothing; Shift+Enter commits the Chinese (user)
Esc then Enter on the same draft shows the translation at once (user)
